sections.section_name: Section A - Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) / Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: Which gardening tool is best used for breaking up hard soil and removing small weeds in a school kitchen garden?
A wheelbarrow is a common tool that makes work easier by carrying heavy loads. It is an example of a ______________ lever.
What is the main purpose of pressing collected fallen leaves between heavy books before adding them to a Biodiversity Register?
options: A) To change their natural color
B) To extract their internal juices
C) To dry them flat and preserve their shape
D) To make them smell better
questions.answer: C) To dry them flat and preserve their shape

questions.question_text: Fill in the blank: _________ is a nutrient-rich organic material added to soil to help kitchen garden plants grow healthy and strong.
Which simple machine consists of a grooved wheel with a rope or cable wrapped around it, often used to lift heavy buckets of water?

sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Define 'mulching' in the context of a school kitchen garden and state its main benefit. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Mulching is the process of covering the soil surface around plants with organic materials like dry leaves or straw. Its main benefit is retaining soil moisture and preventing weeds.

questions.question_text: List three different types of information you should record when observing a new insect for your school Biodiversity Register. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: When observing a new insect, you should record its physical appearance, the specific plant it was found on, and the exact date and time of your observation.

questions.question_text: Explain what an inclined plane is and give one real-life example of how it is used in a school environment. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: An inclined plane is a flat, slanted surface connecting a lower level to a higher level. A real-life example in school is a wheelchair ramp used for easy access.

questions.question_text: Imagine your school wants to build a simple irrigation system for the kitchen garden using maker skills. Describe a basic method using recycled plastic bottles to create a drip irrigation system. [35-45 words]
questions.answer: You can create a drip irrigation system by making tiny holes in the caps of used plastic bottles. Fill the bottles with water, invert them, and bury the cap-end slightly into the soil near the plant roots for a slow, steady water supply.
